youtube.aciklama: According to the World Health Organization, about 60 percent of hearing loss in children is due to preventable causes. Infections such as measles, mumps and rubella can be prevented by vaccination; lack of oxygen during delivery and severe newborn jaundice can also lead to hearing loss. In childhood, early treatment of middle ear problems and hearing screening come first.
